notes: Port list is representative: the switch has 24 total RJ45 ports (16 support 802.3at PoE+, max 32W per PoE+ port, remaining ports support up to 15.4W PoE on some units; total PoE power budget 95W) plus 2x 1G SFP uplink ports, all 1G/100M/10M capable. Only one representative RJ45 port of each type (PoE-capable vs data-only) and both SFP ports are listed to avoid 26 duplicate entries; in practice all 24 RJ45 ports are physically identical in connector type (rj45, eth-1g) and only differ in PoE capability, which is a power spec rather than a signal-connector spec. No console/USB port exists on this model. Power inlet confirmed as standard IEC (C14) inlet based on official spec's AC voltage/wattage figures and third-party accessory listings (C13 power cords sold for this switch); Ubiquiti's tech spec page did not show a photo/diagram explicitly labeling the inlet as C14 vs C7, but the 120W draw rating is consistent with a full IEC C13/C14 pairing rather than a figure-8 low-power inlet. Model has had two hardware "Gen1/Gen2" revisions with a 1.3" touchscreen display added in later units; port counts/connectors are unchanged across revisions.
